decisions.reason: The 518 FLEX is a renamed and upgraded version of the proven BASIC 518 trommel screen, so it builds directly on the firm's core screening knowledge and existing customer feedback.
Mobile high-speed flail shredders sit close to the firm's shredding expertise and get their own web page, so management can interpret early results and refine the product.

The mobile high-speed grinder is related to existing shredding know-how but is only mentioned on the website, so its weaker visibility suggests it is still being evaluated, though the firm can still assimilate the learning.

An electric stationary fine shredder moves into newer drive technology where the firm's knowledge is thinner, but it fits the trend toward electrification and the firm's own R&D can support improvements.
This green-waste grinder variant overlaps with Product C and gets little website presence, which raises some risk of consolidation, but it uses the firm's application knowledge in green waste.
Stationary single-shaft pre-shredders draw on the firm's established shredder engineering and get a dedicated page, signalling commitment and good capacity to learn from market results.
